parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??{}; const clean=v=>String(v??'').trim(); const name=clean(b.name),email=clean(b.email),message=clean(b.message); if(b.website||Date.now()-Number(b.startedAt||0)<1500) throw new Error('Rejected'); if(!name||name.length>100||!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email)||!message||message.length>4000) throw new Error('Invalid contact form'); const d=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const ip=$json.headers?.['x-forwarded-for']||'unknown'; const now=Date.now(); const hits=(d[ip]||[]).filter(t=>now-t<3600000); if(hits.length>=5) throw new Error('Rate limit'); hits.push(now);d[ip]=hits; return [{json:{replyTo:email,subject:`Axiolus contact: ${name}`,text:`From: ${name} <${email}>\n\n${message}`}}];
